title: Forehead, brow ridge, temple and hairline

queue.claim: Soft-tissue forehead inclination (upper-forehead tangent or tr–g′ line vs FH-perpendicular) is about 5–20° backward in adults, women more vertical; suggested prior μ ≈12° men / ≈8° women, σ 5°.
queue.query: soft tissue forehead inclination angle norms adult male female degrees profile anthropometry

queue.claim: Forehead height tr–n′ is about 60–70 mm in men and 55–65 mm in women (SD ≈6–8 mm, North American White-type norms); tr–g′ is about 10–15 mm less.
queue.query: Farkas forehead height trichion nasion trichion glabella adult norms mm male female

queue.claim: Bone-to-skin depth is about 4–6 mm at supraglabella/mid-forehead and frontal eminence, about 6–9 mm at mid-brow (supraorbital) and about 10–25 mm at mid-temple. These feed log-normal priors (glabella μ 5.3 mm, σ_log 0.15; mid-temple μ 15 mm, σ_log 0.35).
queue.query: facial soft tissue thickness supraglabella frontal eminence supraorbital mid-temporal pooled T-table mm

queue.claim: MediaPipe Face Landmarker midline forehead indices run 10 → 151 → 9 → 8 → 168 (10 = top of the mesh, not trichion), and its blendshapes include browInnerUp, browOuterUpLeft/Right and browDownLeft/Right.
queue.query: MediaPipe face mesh canonical landmark index 10 151 9 8 168 forehead midline browInnerUp blendshape
